mariageNous.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
mariageNous.modeDuoMeta: Your wedding as a couple and where you disagree
mariageNous.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
mariageNous.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
mariageNous.setupTitreDuo: What kind of wedding is right for you as a couple?
mariageNous.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then passes the phone. At the end, you'll see your wedding as a couple and the questions where you don't agree.
mariageNous.setupTitreSolo: What kind of wedding is right for you as a couple?
mariageNous.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about your wedding day, for example about the number of guests or the music. Answer with your couple in mind and you'll see which wedding would suit you best.
mariageNous.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
mariageNous.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
mariageNous.chacunMeme: On your own, you would each have picked the same wedding. Now you just have to set the date!
mariageNous.chacunGagne: Your wedding as a couple is {{nom}}'s pick. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
mariageNous.chacunCompromis: Your wedding as a couple isn't the one either of you picked alone. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
mariageNous.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
mariageNous.accordHaut: You picture more or less the same wedding.
mariageNous.accordMoyen: You agree on the main things but there are two or three points left to talk about.
mariageNous.accordBas: You don't picture the same wedding at all. Talk it over before you visit a venue!
mariageNous.jaugesTitre: The weddings that would suit you best
mariageNous.invitationDuo: And what kind of wedding does your partner picture? Take the quiz again together to see which questions you disagree on.
mariageNous.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It gives you an idea but it doesn't replace a wedding planner's advice. The photos were created for this page.
mariageNous.p_chateau_d: It's a big wedding in a castle or a stately home, with a long driveway, chandeliers and very well-dressed guests. You want a day everyone will remember, with both families there and a proper dinner. It's the fairy-tale wedding and you're fine with that!
mariageNous.p_chateau_a: Castles are often booked more than a year ahead and the guest list grows fast. Set the budget and the number of guests first. You can visit venues after that.
mariageNous.p_champetre_d: It's a wedding in a meadow or a barn, with string lights and long wooden tables. You want everyone to feel at ease and the children to be able to run around. You'll dance outdoors until the end of the night.
mariageNous.p_champetre_a: When you get married outdoors, you always need a plan in case it rains. Have a tent or a hall right next door. Ask a few friends to help you set everything up the day before too.
mariageNous.p_jardin_d: It's a small wedding for about thirty people in a lovely garden in town, with champagne and good food. You'd rather be able to talk to every guest than hire a big hall. It's an elegant wedding but without any fuss.
mariageNous.p_jardin_a: The hardest part will be the guest list, because with thirty people you have to choose. Agree on a simple rule and stick to it. For example, you could invite only close family and your oldest friends.
mariageNous.p_foret_d: It's a ceremony in a forest clearing, with wooden benches and light coming through the trees. You want a wedding like no other, with a ceremony written by you or by your friends. The evening will end around a campfire.
mariageNous.p_foret_a: Find out early whether you're allowed to use the place. Think about your oldest guests too. They need an easy path, chairs and a shelter in case it rains.
mariageNous.p_plage_d: It's a wedding with your feet in the sand, with an arch facing the sea and the sunset for the photos. You want the day to feel like a holiday, without too much formality. The guests will leave their shoes in a basket!
mariageNous.p_plage_a: On a beach, you have to reckon with the wind and the tide. Ask the local council for permission and plan a sound system that's loud enough. Have somewhere to go if the weather turns bad too.
mariageNous.p_mairie_t: City hall, then a great restaurant
mariageNous.p_mairie_d: You say yes at city hall, you take a photo on the steps and you go for lunch in a restaurant you love. You don't need a year of planning to get married. What matters to you is being with the right people and eating well.
mariageNous.p_mairie_a: A simple wedding still needs a bit of planning. Book the restaurant early. Tell the family and friends who expected a big party too, so they aren't disappointed.
mariageNous.p_montagne_d: It's a wedding in a chalet, with snow or alpine meadows and the peaks behind you in the photos. You want few guests and you want to keep them for two or three days. You'll go walking in the morning and party by the fire in the evening.
mariageNous.p_montagne_a: Not everyone finds it easy to get up a mountain. Think about places to stay nearby and about the grandparents. Have a plan in case the weather changes too, because it changes fast up there.
mariageNous.p_deux_d: You go off to get married on the other side of the world, with no guests. You want to live this moment for yourselves, with no seating plan and no speeches, in a place you'll never forget. Your family and friends will see the photos and you'll throw a party when you get back.
mariageNous.p_deux_a: Check the paperwork before you leave. A wedding held abroad isn't always recognised automatically when you get home. Tell your families before you go rather than after too.
mariageNous.p_vignes_d: It's a wedding on a wine estate, with a long dinner outdoors between the rows of vines and the estate's wine on the tables. You like to eat well, drink well and take your time. The light at the end of summer is perfect for photos.
mariageNous.p_vignes_a: Vineyards are in high demand at the end of summer, so book early. Taste the wine before you sign. Arrange shuttles too, so that nobody has to drive home.
mariageNous.p_fete_d: It's a three-day party with tents, live music and food trucks. Your guests sleep on site. For you, a wedding is first of all a very big party and one evening wouldn't be enough. You just ask your guests to come dressed however they like.
mariageNous.p_fete_a: A three-day party is organised like a small festival. For example, you have to think about toilets, electricity and the neighbours. Ask friends who enjoy organising to help you.
